notes: 8x4 HDMI matrix switcher with audio de-embedding, part of the DXP HD 4K PLUS series (42/44/84/88). Primary source is Extron's official specification sheet (DXP_HD_4K_PLUS_Series_5640-D11.pdf, doc 4798-D5, retrieved via ezpro.com mirror since extron.com blocks automated fetches) plus the official Setup Guide (68-2939-50_A.pdf) for rear-panel connector labeling. Video: HDMI 2.0, HDCP 1.4/2.2, max 18 Gbps (6 Gbps/color), 4K(4096x2160)/UHD(3840x2160) @60Hz 4:4:4 -> graded hdmi-2.0. Ethernet is 10/100Base-T -> graded eth-100m. RS-232 and analog audio outputs use 3.5mm captive-screw (3-pole and 5-pole respectively); mapped to the closest available connector id 'euroblock' (no ungraded connector omitted). S/PDIF digital audio outputs are on female RCA jacks (75 ohm) — present only on DXP 44/84/88 variants (confirmed included on the 84). Front-panel USB port is a USB 2.0 Mini-B "Config" port used for control/firmware, not a host/peripheral data port; mapped to 'usb-micro' as the closest listed connector id since 'usb-mini-b' is not in the allowed list — treated as bidirectional control since it functions as a PC-to-device control link (same protocol as RS-232/Ethernet). AC power: internal supply, standard IEC power cord (provided) into rear IEC inlet — mapped to 'iec' (C13/C14 style). Unit is 1U rack-mountable, full rack width, with included rack ears (per the 44/84/88 series spec; the smaller DXP 42 is half-rack/external PSU and not applicable here). No dedicated IR port exists on this model.
